name: tufu AI – Chatbot & Live Chat with WooCommerce Order Tracking
author: tufu

sections.description:
tufu answers your visitors from your own pages, docs and files, with a link to the page every answer came from. When it can’t help, the conversation goes to your team, and you reply from one inbox.

The plugin puts three things on your site, with no code. Free to start, connected in a minute, no API key to copy.

💬 Support chat

  • A chat bubble on every page, or only the pages you choose. Or an Ask bar at the bottom of the page instead.
  • It replies in the language each visitor writes in.
  • Your colors in one click (“Match my website”), or, on paid plans, an animated character.
  • Every answer links to the page it came from.
  • “Talk to a person” sends the conversation to your team: in the tufu inbox, by email, and in Slack or Discord on paid plans. Your reply reaches the visitor in the chat, or by email if they’ve left.
  • WooCommerce: “where’s my order?” On Team and Scale, the bot looks up a customer’s own order (status, items, tracking), for logged-in customers and guest checkouts. Read-only: never addresses or payment details. How it works

🔎 Docs search

The “tufu Ask” block, or the [tufu_ask] shortcode, puts a search box for your docs on any page. Visitors get a short answer and the pages to read.

📝 Forms

Build a form in tufu, then show it with the “tufu Form” block or [tufu_form id="..."]. Every message lands in your tufu inbox, where your team replies by email.

  • Drag-and-drop builder, steps with Back and Next, columns, a date picker, ratings and 45 ready-made templates, on every plan.
  • From Starter: fields and steps that show only after an answer, and sending each message to Mailchimp, Kit, HubSpot, Google Sheets or a webhook.
  • The AI is off until you turn it on. Then it can suggest a reply for your team, or answer the visitor first from your docs.
  • Moving from Ninja Forms, WPForms or Contact Form 7? Settings > tufu AI > “Move my forms” copies their forms into tufu. Tick “Show this form where the old shortcode is”, and once the old plugin is off, its shortcodes show the tufu form instead.

🌱 Free, with a free plan

Connecting takes a minute: press “Connect to tufu”, sign in or create a free account, pick a bot, and you’re back. No API key to copy.

The plugin has no paid version and nothing locked. It shows a service that runs on tufu.ai, so you need a tufu account. The free plan includes one bot with the chat and the Ask console, and one form. Paid plans add more bots, answers, forms and channels (pricing). Plan limits are counted by tufu, not by this plugin.

On the free plan, the chat, the Ask console and forms show a small “Powered by tufu” link to https://tufu.ai. On Scale, or on Starter and Team with the brand removal add-on, you can hide it in tufu.

External services

The plugin connects your site to tufu (https://tufu.ai). Nothing is loaded or sent until you connect a bot or add a tufu form. Here is what goes to tufu, and when:

  • When you connect. Pressing “Connect to tufu” opens https://tufu.ai/connect/wordpress/ with your site’s address and a one-time code. You sign in there and pick a bot, and tufu sends back the bot’s public IDs. No password or key passes through your site. “Choose a form in tufu” works the same way and returns only the form’s public ID and name.
  • On pages with the chat or the Ask console. Visitors’ browsers load tufu’s script from https://tufu.ai/widget/v1/ and the bot’s public settings. What a visitor types is sent to tufu so the bot can answer, along with the page address, the usual request data (IP address, browser) and the plugin’s name and version (wordpress/0.7.0). If a visitor asks for a person and leaves an email address, tufu uses it to send your reply.
  • On pages with a tufu form. Your site fetches the form’s layout from https://tufu.ai/f/, and visitors’ browsers load the form script from https://tufu.ai/widget/v1/. The visitor’s answers go to tufu when they press Send. tufu counts views and starts without cookies.
  • When you move forms. “Move my forms” sends the other plugin’s form layouts (fields and settings, never entries) to tufu, only after you press it.
  • Signed-in visitors (optional, off by default). With an identity secret pasted, the chat tells tufu who a logged-in user is (user ID, email, display name) with a one-hour token from your site. Logged-out visitors are never identified.
  • WooCommerce orders (optional, off by default). With a signing secret pasted, tufu can ask your site at /wp-json/tufu-ai/v1/orders for a customer’s own orders, in signed requests only. The answer holds the order number, status, date, total, items, shipping method and tracking, and never addresses, phone numbers, payment details or notes. A guest gets only the one order whose number and billing email they both give.

On your site, the plugin stores only its settings, its list of tufu forms and the secrets you paste (shown back as their last four characters). It sets no cookies. The chat remembers a visitor’s conversation in their browser’s storage for tufu.ai.

  • Terms of Service: https://tufu.ai/terms/
  • Privacy Policy: https://tufu.ai/privacy/
sections.installation:
1. In WordPress, go to Plugins > Add New Plugin, search for “tufu AI”, then press Install Now and Activate.
  2. Go to Settings > tufu AI and press “Connect to tufu”.
  3. Sign in to tufu, or create a free account, and pick your bot (or make one). You come back to WordPress with it saved, and the chat bubble shows on your site.
  4. For a docs search box, add the “tufu Ask” block or the [tufu_ask] shortcode. For a form, add the “tufu Form” block and choose a form.

Prefer to type it in? Under “Enter IDs instead”, fill in the team and bot IDs from your bot’s “Put it on your site” page in tufu. Full guide
sections.faq:
How much does it cost?

The plugin is free, and so is tufu’s free plan: one bot with the chat and the Ask console, and one form. Paid plans add more bots, answers and forms, and form connections; Team and Scale add the WooCommerce order lookup. Pricing

Do I need a tufu account?

Yes, a free one. “Connect to tufu” in Settings > tufu AI creates it or signs you in, and brings you back to WordPress.

How is tufu different from AI Engine?

AI Engine is a toolkit run inside WordPress with your own AI keys. tufu is a service for support: answers from your site with sources, and your team when it can’t help. No AI key to set up.

Does it slow my site down?

The script loads only on pages that show the chat, the Ask console or a form, as a small module after the page, and browsers cache it. The chat itself loads when a visitor opens it.

The chat bubble doesn’t show

Check that “Show the chat bubble” is ticked and that the bot’s page rules in tufu allow the page. With a caching plugin, clear its cache after connecting. “Check it’s live on tufu” in Settings > tufu AI says whether the bubble has loaded on your site.

I use Cloudflare Rocket Loader

The plugin asks Rocket Loader to skip tufu’s script. If the bubble still doesn’t show, turn Rocket Loader off with a Page Rule, or exclude the script in your optimization plugin.

Does it work with Divi or Elementor?

Yes, and the bubble stays out of their editors. Without blocks, use the shortcodes. Divi guide

Shortcode options

[tufu_ask placeholder=”Search the help” hotkey=”k” bot=”docs”]: placeholder is the text in the box, hotkey the letter that opens it with Cmd or Ctrl (hotkey="" turns it off), bot another bot of the same team. For [tufu_form id="..."], Settings > tufu AI lists your forms with each one’s shortcode to copy.

Can the bot answer “where’s my order?”

Yes, on tufu’s Team and Scale plans. Paste both secrets from your bot’s Look it up tab under Settings > tufu AI > “Signed-in visitors and orders”, then add “WooCommerce orders” on that tab. Setup guide

Do forms work without JavaScript or behind a page cache?

Yes. A tufu form is a real HTML form, so it sends with JavaScript off and on cached pages. Steps then show as one page.

What happens when I delete the plugin?

Its settings and secrets are removed from your site (every site, on a multisite network). Your bots, forms and conversations stay in tufu.

screenshots.caption: AI support chat for WordPress: answers from your own pages, with the source linked, and a person one click away.
Everything support needs in one plugin: sources, handoff, WooCommerce orders, forms, docs search and your visitors' language.
Live in three steps: connect, add your pages, and the chat answers on every page.
When the bot can't help, the conversation lands in your inbox with a suggested reply.
"Where's my order?" answered on WooCommerce: status, items and tracking, for the customer's own orders.
Forms with drag and drop, steps, conditional logic, a date picker and 45 templates.
Match your site in one click, or swap the chat button for an animated character (paid plans).
